method: Inspected every generated full-context and native-scale cropped tile in visual-01.jpg and visual-02.jpg, before running fit. Green circle is measured threshold edge; cyan cross is edge minus29px. Predictions were absent.

clips.61: Frames36,37,38: clear downward-moving warm trail head on floor to right of board. No deck intersection or hard scenery edge at measured front.
clips.90: Frames50,92: clear isolated diagonally moving heads; board nearby but not at threshold front. Only threshold30 qualifies; retain for sensitivity, absent primary25.
clips.93: Frame99: clear leftward-moving head in floor region beneath board; no board intersection at front. Single frame only.
clips.99: Frames78,79: clear upward-moving head after initial hold. Selected front is in moving leg, not held endpoint. No inference about hold duration.
clips.118: Frames12,14,18: clear upper-left-moving head on floor to right of board. Board/scenery do not cross selected head.
clips.121: Frame94: clear downward-moving head on floor left of board, away from preceding kink. Single frame only.
clips.153: Frames23,30,37: clear downward-moving head on open floor right of board. Broad illumination gradients remain a background-model risk, but no salient stripe or deck intersection at head.

coverage_limitation: Only7of100clips qualify at anythreshold; primary25 has27frames from6clips, development3clips across2recordings and heldout3clips across3recordings. Manual validation covers representative endpoints/middle of every selected run, not independent human touch centre timestamps.
